quote: The metric score measures the degree of a LM prefering the more stereotypical sentence of the pair, (anti)stereo score adjusts this metric based on the target bias orientation.
Participants were recruited through calls for volunteers posted to social media and mailing lists in the French research community.
guideline: participants were asked to submit a statement that expressed a stereotype in French along with a selection of ten bias types... participants were presented with a translation into French of a sentence from CrowS-pairs and asked to assess sentence fluency... participants were presented with a translated sentence and asked to select the bias category they associated with it.
